title: WfGg Radar operational discovery and controlled runtime evolution
problem: Allow the user to stop only the currently running manual Radar search from the same UI button, without affecting Autopilot, production behavior, Last War read-only guarantees, or token handling.
goals: During a manual search, transform the RECHERCHER button into STOP.
STOP cancels only the active manual search job.
After cancellation completes, restore the button to RECHERCHER.
Preserve V6.19.10 Autopilot continue-on-partial-limit behavior unchanged.
Qualify the runtime STOP route with a guard-only probe that executes no Last War scan and no Collector mutation.
non_goals: Do not stop or alter Autopilot jobs.
Do not promote or deploy V6.19.11 to production during this pilot.
Do not execute a Last War scan during the guard probe.
Do not persist Last War tokens.
Do not change V6.19.10 production behavior.

current_change.purpose: Add a manual-search-only cancellation path and RECHERCHER -> STOP -> RECHERCHER UI state transition.

acceptance_criteria: The V6.19.11 connector binary SHA256 is 4d66709f10d3a6b27ac255a1dfdc62e51d2817652634409ffe2edc071762c69f.
The connector exposes POST /v1/collector/search/stop and MANUAL_SEARCH_STOPPED.
The UI exposes manualSearchRunning, manualSearchStopping and requestManualSearchStop.
During a manual search the button label becomes STOP; while stopping it becomes ARRÊT…; after termination it returns to RECHERCHER.
STOP targets only the active manual search job.
The guard probe validates STOP/status route guards without starting a Last War scan.
The guard probe performs no Collector mutation.
Pilot installation is SHA-pinned and rollback-capable.
Production promotion or deployment requires a separate explicit human approval.
architecture_invariants: GitHub stores code, branches, CI and release artifacts.
ChaCha DEV on ChaChaVPS is the runtime orchestrator.
ChaChaNas remains authoritative persistent storage for project data and backups.
VPS is runtime-oriented and not the authoritative durable project store.
Producer and verifier responsibilities remain separated.
